product.name: Hyundai CRETA
product.summary: A five-door, five-seat, front-wheel-drive compact SUV. The supplied September 2026 compilation lists three engines and ten trim columns.
product.audience: Buyers comparing everyday city use and longer journeys.

brand.voice_style: Plain spoken English that translates supported features into ordinary situations.
dos: Preserve exact trim and engine scope.
Distinguish manufacturer descriptions from measured results.
donts: Do not claim superiority or guarantees absent from evidence.
Do not invent timing, mileage, capacity or safety results.
brand.persona_hint: A product guide; inferred restrained profile, not an uploaded brand guideline.
